heading: Getting to Know the Thermomix TM7

items.q: What is the Thermomix TM7?
items.a: The Thermomix® TM7™ is Vorwerk's latest all-in-one cooking robot. It blends, chops, weighs, steams, kneads, mixes, and cooks with guided, step-by-step recipes on a 10-inch full touchscreen — replacing more than 20 separate kitchen appliances with one countertop machine.

items.q: When was the Thermomix TM7 released?
items.a: The TM7 was announced on February 14, 2025, with Canadian pre-orders opening April 3, 2025, and it has since become Vorwerk's current flagship model.

items.q: Has the Thermomix TM7 won any design awards?
items.a: Yes — the TM7 won the iF Design Award 2026 twice, in both the Product Design (Kitchen Appliances) and User Experience categories, confirmed at the iF Design Award Night in Berlin in April 2026. Including a German Design Award, a Red Dot Award, and several others, the TM7 has picked up around a dozen major international design and innovation awards in its first year on sale.

heading: Price, Shipping & Where to Buy in Canada

items.q: How much does the Thermomix TM7 cost in Canada?
items.a: The Thermomix TM7 is priced at $2,299 CAD before tax. Vorwerk also offers financing through Affirm or PayPlan by RBC for qualifying customers — rates vary, and 0% APR only applies when that promotion is live.

items.q: Where can I buy a Thermomix TM7 in Canada?
items.a: Thermomix is sold exclusively through independent Vorwerk consultants — you won't find it at Costco, Amazon, Best Buy, or any retail store. This consultant-only model is how Vorwerk keeps pricing consistent nationwide and guarantees authentic Canadian warranty coverage.

items.q: Is free shipping available on the Thermomix TM7?
items.a: Yes — free shipping across Canada is available when you order through a Vorwerk consultant link, including mine.

items.q: Is Thermomix available where I live in Canada?
items.a: Yes — Thermomix has no physical stores anywhere in Canada, whether that's downtown Toronto, Winnipeg, Prince Edward Island, or a small town in between. It's sold exclusively through independent Vorwerk consultants, with free shipping to every province through my consultant link.

items.q: What is the difference between the Thermomix TM6 and TM7?
items.a: The TM7 swaps the TM6's 6.8-inch screen and physical control wheel for a fully touch-based 10-inch display, redesigns the Varoma from oval to rectangular for about 40% more steaming capacity, runs quieter, and adds a heat-insulated bowl cover that stays cool to the touch. It also introduces Open Cooking mode — cooking uncovered up to 100°C with no blade rotation — and supports manual browning in both guided and manual modes.

items.q: Is the Thermomix TM7 more powerful than the TM6?
items.a: It's not weaker — owners report the TM7 handles heavy loads at least as well as the TM6. What's changed is noise: at soft speed and speed 1 with the bowl full of water, Vorwerk measures the TM7 at roughly 35 dB(A) versus the TM6's 63 dB(A), so Vorwerk clearly prioritized quieter running without giving up power.

items.q: Should TM6 owners upgrade to the TM7?
items.a: Vorwerk no longer sells the TM6 new — the TM7 is the only current model, so this decision is mostly moot for new buyers. Existing TM6 owners don't need to rush: Vorwerk continues to support the TM6 with parts and service for up to 10 years from purchase, so it's worth upgrading only if you specifically want the larger touchscreen, bigger Varoma, or quieter motor.

items.q: What is Cookidoo, and is it included with the TM7?
items.a: Cookidoo is Vorwerk's recipe platform, connecting directly to the TM7 with over 100,000 guided, step-by-step recipes and built-in meal planning. New TM7 owners get a free 3-month Cookidoo trial; after that, a subscription runs $89 CAD per year. A subscription isn't mandatory — you can still cook manually or use built-in recipes without one.

items.q: Can the TM7 use TM6 and TM5 recipes?
items.a: Yes — the Thermomix TM7 is backward-compatible with recipes created for the TM5 and TM6.

items.q: What warranty comes with the Thermomix TM7?
items.a: Every TM7 includes a complimentary 2-year limited manufacturer warranty covering mechanical and electronic defects not caused by misuse — Vorwerk repairs or replaces the unit at no cost within that period.

items.q: Is the Thermomix TM7 dishwasher safe?
items.a: Most of the TM7's components — the mixing bowl, lid, Varoma set, and spatula — are dishwasher-safe. The machine also has a built-in pre-clean mode that rinses the bowl and blades between uses.

items.q: Is the Thermomix TM7 quieter than the TM6?
items.a: Yes. Noise reduction was one of Vorwerk's design goals for the TM7, and owners upgrading from the TM6 consistently report noticeably quieter operation, especially at lower speeds — high-speed blending is still audible.

items.q: What's included when you buy a Thermomix TM7?
items.a: Every TM7 ships with the mixing bowl and lid, mixing blade, spatula, butterfly whisk, simmering basket, and a Varoma steaming set (dish, lid, and tray), plus a free Blade Cover & Peeler and a free 3-month Cookidoo trial.

items.q: Are TM6 accessories compatible with the TM7?
items.a: Only the current Blade Cover & Peeler and the Thermomix Sensor carry over to the TM7 — most older TM5/TM6 attachments don't fit the new bowl and lid design.

items.q: Is the Thermomix TM7 worth it?
items.a: If you cook several times a week and want an all-in-one guided-cooking system, most reviewers find the larger touchscreen, quieter motor, and bigger Varoma worth the investment. If you cook only occasionally, a standalone appliance may suit you better.

items.q: What's the benefit of buying through your consultant link instead of directly?
items.a: Your order still goes through Vorwerk's own official Canadian store — my consultant link doesn't change the price, since Vorwerk sets TM7 pricing centrally. What it does unlock is free shipping, the same current promotions anyone shopping directly would see, and a real person attached to your order for support and warranty questions.

items.q: Can I buy a Thermomix TM7 without sitting through a demo?
items.a: Yes. Thermomix is normally sold after an in-home or online Cooking Experience demo, which can run 3-4 hours in practice. If you've already made up your mind — from social media, reviews, or your own research — you don't need to book one. My consultant link takes you straight to checkout with the same current pricing and promotions, no demo required.

items.q: Can I buy a Thermomix TM7 directly from Vorwerk without a consultant?
items.a: Technically yes — Vorwerk's checkout has a 'continue without a consultant' option. But Vorwerk states plainly that removing a consultant means your TM7 won't qualify for free shipping, and you'd also miss the complimentary Welcome Service and a named consultant for support and warranty questions. The price is identical either way, so there's no downside to keeping my consultant link attached, and every upside: free shipping across Canada, at no extra cost to you.

items.q: Is there current financing available on the Thermomix TM7?
items.a: Vorwerk periodically runs 0% APR financing on the TM7 — for example, 12 monthly payments with no interest — through Affirm or PayPlan by RBC for qualifying customers. My consultant link opens Vorwerk's own storefront, so whatever financing or promotion is live applies automatically.
